notes.title: Thank You + Free Soundtrack + Updates
notes.notes:
Hello meat enjoyers,

Thank you all for the amazing response to the game — it has been surreal seeing so many people playing and enjoying the experience, the response was unexpected. I really appreciate the support.

[b]If you enjoyed the game, please consider leaving a review on Steam — it genuinely helps a lot.[/b]

As a small thank you, the full game soundtrack is now available for free, including some unused tracks:
🎧 Download the OST here: [url=https://www.torgomind.com/naviculaost]www.torgomind.com/naviculaost[/url]

Due to popular demand, I've also uploaded an extended version of the disco song to Youtube, along with all the main songs:

[previewyoutube=Nwp6ZCJpOXY;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=IpPxHkp-R_w;full][/previewyoutube]

For those who are stuck on puzzles or who wish to explore deeper into the game I wrote a subtle hint guide available [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3470534115]here[/url].

I have been considering some future content relating to the game, let me know if that's something you'd be interested in. Otherwise, there is already a new project quietly taking shape behind the scenes. Stay tuned.

Thanks again,
Torgo . :)

notes.title: NAVICULA MEATUS launches April 25
notes.notes:
"NAVICULA MEATUS" releases April 25 on Steam.

A dark and surreal puzzle adventure set in a decaying town where veins pulse through ruined structures and the night hums with unfamiliar life.

A surreal puzzle-adventure game set in a peculiar world of murky alleys and fleshy growths. Explore a decaying town shrouded in mystery, interact with its charming denizens. Become a crustacean and utilise the unique puzzle-crawler grid-based meat systems.

📌 Wishlist now to be notified when the membrane ruptures.
